_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. M-092 upgrade rules of THIS release (the target of an upgrade). Every release appends what it removes or deprecates; 0.1.0 is the first release, so nothing is removed yet. models.constructs[]: {namespace, element, attribute?, attributeNamespace?, value?, status: removed|deprecated, note}; '*' matches any namespace or element (an attribute rule then matches on any element). config.removed / renamed: Spring keys (relaxed form, prefix match); config.removedEnv / renamedEnv: environment variable names for .env files.
